input.args: Write the "one more service" rule from notes/issue-70.md into docs/ so the next service proposal starts from it. This is the third time this year (Redis for sessions in 2023, Redis for Celery in March 2025, Elasticsearch in October 2025) that someone proposed adding infrastructure. Ana (maintainer)'s rule: larder runs one database and one web app; a new service must do something Postgres cannot, with two volunteers able to restore it; exceptions exist for hosted services nobody has to run (e.g. the card gateway). Find the right doc (likely an architecture or tenets page per docs/README.md) and record this as a durable decision/tenet, citing the concrete incidents as evidence.

last_message:
I've written the recurring "one more service" argument into `docs/`:

- **`docs/philosophy.md`** (new) — the tenet *"Larder runs one database and one web app"*: a new service is rejected unless it does something Postgres cannot and two volunteers can restore it, with hosted services like the card gateway exempted. This is the kind the map reserves for cross-cutting rules that guide many decisions.
- **`docs/adr/0003-search-pantry-items-in-postgres.md`** (new) — records the concrete decision from `notes/issue-70.md`: Elasticsearch was rejected in favor of Postgres full-text search for pantry item search, citing the same pattern from the two earlier Redis incidents (2023 sessions, March 2025 Celery queue).
- Updated `docs/adr/README.md` to list the new record, and linked the tenet to all three ADRs that apply it (0001, 0002, 0003).

Next time this proposal comes up, `docs/philosophy.md` is where it should start.
